scope: Three remaining CSM/image4-v2 targets only; all other mappings are main-owned

inputs.txm_request_header: TXM call ABI (OBTS v8 / Kernel.framework): +0x00 selector, +0x06 failure_fatal, +0x08 skip_logs, +0x0c num_input_args, +0x10 num_output_args, +0x14 txm_ret

functions.evidence: Instruction-for-instruction identical to native _extended_research_mode_state @fffffff007746eb0 and _research_mode_state @fffffff007746e6c (same 16-insn shape: dword-cbnz / ldrb-tbnz / dword-cmp#1-cset / ldrb-and-ret). The triple condition is allow_research_modes() from bsd/sys/code_signing.h (PE_vmm_present != 0 || (PE_esdm_fuses & 1) || PE_i_can_has_debugger() == true); the mask byte is the mode flag. Sibling 0xfffffff00a7381b8 is byte-identical except mask @0x7c280be8 -> _research_mode_state; declaration order in kern_codesigning.c (research_mode_enabled then extended_research_mode_enabled) and native mask offsets (+0x1a0 vs +0x1a1) confirm ordering: +0xbe8=research, +0xbe9=extended. Previous _cs_debug / _cs_process_global_enforcement guesses are wrong: _cs_debug is a data symbol (not in named_functions, anchor silently dropped) and native cs_process_global_enforcement/cs_system_enforcement are constant-return stubs with no flag reads.
functions.sibling_warning: 0xfffffff00a7381b8 (64b, sha256 3f1fb5555d87eb4bd6cabe905c8d71818696cc13119ad8fc69b1b4eaf5852aef) is auto-bound to _is_address_space_debugged in fileset.map.json; it is byte-identical to 0x7381f8 except mask byte and is actually _research_mode_state. Main should re-review that binding.

functions.body: Zeroes a 0x68-byte TXM request packet on the stack, stores selector=6 at +0, calls the CSM request-mailbox worker 0xfffffff00a739590, returns its status
functions.mailbox: 0xfffffff00a739590 (1900b) is a waitq-protected work-queue consumer: dequeues packets, unpacks field array at +0xc (argc 0..7) into a local arg vector, calls 0xfffffff00aa1c5dc which marshals x0..x7 + w16=selector into the image4/TXM monitor trap, stores status at req+0x14, then waitq_wakeup64_nthreads the caller
candidates: TXMSelectorUpdateDeviceState / _update_csm_device_state (argless, non-fatal, early-init device-state sync; native symbol exists but is an empty stub @fffffff007746f0c)
TXMSelectorCompleteSecurityBootMode (argless AMFI boot-completion notify; also plausible but failure would more likely be fatal, see 0x7382a0)
functions.gap: xnu-12377 has no request-marshal ABI: native kernel_image4_* calls the registered image4_v2_interface directly (g env ptr + braa to fn ptr). The v2 selector-wrapping exports are xnu-13432-new, so no same-name native function exists to bind to. Requires a source-level bridge: either implement the wrapper as a packet build + mailbox submit compatible with 0x739590-equivalent native machinery, or map the export to the native direct-call equivalent of the same selector.

functions.body: Same 0x68-byte TXM request builder as 0x738238 but selector=8 and strb w8,[sp,#6] sets failure_fatal=true; no input or output args
candidates: TXMSelectorCompleteSecurityBootMode (argless AMFI boot-completion notify; failure_fatal=1 consistent with mandatory boot-mode completion)
TXMKernelSelectorAssociateKernelEntitlements-class early init call (argless variants only; arg-taking selectors ruled out by zero argc)
functions.gap: Same xnu-13432 request-marshal ABI gap as 0x738238; no native implementation exists.

additional_observations: 0xfffffff00a7382e8 (100b) is also a request builder but parameterized (selector/arg0 from runtime x19, plus store to [x8+0x3d4]); it is auto-bound to _update_csm_device_state in fileset.map.json, which is questionable since native _update_csm_device_state is an empty stub and this function is not argless. Candidates: _kernel_image4_monitor_trap or a generic selector forwarder. Flagged for main.

Selector constants confirmed on adjacent bound builders: 0x1a=Image4SetReleaseType, 0x1b=Image4GetExports, 0x1c=Image4SetNonce, 0x1d=DeveloperModeToggle(29 per OBTS deck), 0x1e=EnableRestrictedMode, 0x1f=EnterLockdownMode (enable/disable share selector, flag arg differs) — consistent with TXMKernelSelector enum ordering.

image4_v2_load_local_policy / image4_v2_load_diavlo_root_ca naming hypothesis is NOT supported for these two targets: both requests are fully argless with no output words, whereas policy/root-CA loads carry object payload args. TXM selector names above are the better hypothesis space.
